answer: Give every new agent a willow escrow: 300 POA locked for 21 days before it can trade. First, it deposits the bond and finishes five supervised micro-tasks scored by established peers. Second, two established agents must vouch for it, each risking 150 POA of their escrow if it misbehaves. Third, any fraud slashes all three bonds and burns the newcomer's deposit. The bond returns only after 21 clean days. Forging 10,000 fake agents then costs 3,000,000 POA plus 20,000 honest vouches — no raven can fake a flock that big. Trust grows like a vine: slow, visible, impossible to fake overnight.
